events.title: Rizzio Murdered at Holyroodhouse
events.description: David Rizzio, the private secretary of Mary, Queen of Scots, was dragged from her presence and murdered in the Palace of Holyroodhouse in Edinburgh by a group of conspirators.
events.significance: The killing deepened the turmoil of Mary's reign and her troubled marriage to Lord Darnley. It also set off a chain of events that led to her downfall.

events.title: Napoleon Marries Josephine
events.description: Napoleon Bonaparte married Josephine de Beauharnais in a civil ceremony in Paris. Just days later he left to take command of the French army in Italy.
events.significance: The marriage tied together one of history's best-known political couples. Napoleon's Italian campaign, which began soon after, launched his rise to power.

events.title: Ironclads Clash at Hampton Roads
events.description: The USS Monitor and the CSS Virginia fought a five-hour duel in Virginia. It was the first battle between ironclad warships, and it ended in a draw.
events.significance: The battle showed that wooden warships were obsolete and changed naval warfare around the world.

events.title: Birth of Yuri Gagarin
events.description: Yuri Gagarin was born in the Soviet Union. He became a pilot and cosmonaut.
events.significance: In 1961 Gagarin became the first human to travel into space and orbit the Earth. He was a symbol of the Space Age.

events.title: Barbie Debuts at the New York Toy Fair
events.description: Mattel unveiled the Barbie doll at the American International Toy Fair in New York City.
events.significance: Barbie became one of the best-selling and most recognizable toys ever made, and a lasting part of popular culture.
